title: Record the Section a person assigns as a training label
description: Backend then UI on the Mac. Today a Reference carries only accepted or rejected, so there is no human ground truth for which Section it belongs in. Add an optional Section on a human (or delegated) accept, stored in the curation metadata with the same human-only rule and delegation quote, exposed through recordDelegatedCuration and the CLI. Section labels count only when a person explicitly set them; links inferred from stories are proposals a person must confirm, never labels.
